name: Ham Ninh crab
summary: Crab boiled as soon as it comes off the boat, red-shelled with firm, fragrant meat, dipped in salt, pepper, and lime. The smaller crabs carry more flavour.
origin: Hàm Ninh, Phu Quoc. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the village is 20 km northeast of Dương Đông. The specialty-seafood account says 20 km from Duong Dong town. Both distances stay.
taste: Firm meat on the Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam account, dipped in muối tiêu chanh. Fragrant and aromatic on the specialty-seafood account, dipped in lime and pepper sauce. That account says the smaller crab has more flavour.
howToEat: Eat it boiled, in the fishing village, with the sea wind. The crab is there almost all year.
Other island kitchens serve it too, but Hàm Ninh is the shore for it.
where: Làng chài Hàm Ninh, about 20 km northeast of Dương Đông.
seoTitle: Ghe Ham Ninh — boiled crab on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Ghẹ Hàm Ninh is crab boiled straight off the boat and dipped in salt, pepper, and lime, in the fishing village east of Dương Đông.
